message: `POST /admin/credentials/{id}/rotate` rotates an upstream provider credential with a bounded overlap window: the previous material stays usable only while the new material will not resolve, for `key_management.crypto.rotation.credential_grace_secs`. Credential views carry `rotated_at` and `rotation_age_days`, and `sbproxy_key_rotation_age_days` is the gauge to alert against the named crypto periods.
